categories.main_business_segments: Tianli Lithium Energy Group primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery cathode materials, including ternary materials (nickel-cobalt-manganese and nickel-cobalt-aluminum), lithium iron phosphate, and lithium carbonate. These products serve the power battery, energy storage battery, electric bicycle, electric tools, and 3C electronics sectors. The company also operates in lithium carbonate recycling and resource regeneration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced preparation technologies for ternary cathode materials, including high-nickel series, single crystal series, and high-voltage series. It employs an order-driven production model with strict quality control and process optimization. R&D focuses on high-nickel materials, long-cycle lithium iron phosphate, and recycling technologies, supported by a strong patent portfolio and collaborations with academic and industry partners.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic lithium battery manufacturers such as Honeycomb Energy, Xingheng Power, Changhong Sanjie, and others. The end markets served are primarily new energy vehicles, electric bicycles, energy storage systems, electric tools, and consumer electronics. The company targets both small power battery markets and high-end new energy vehicle battery segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales outside Henan Province accounting for over 87% of revenue. It has production and R&D facilities in Henan, Anhui, Sichuan, and other provinces, and subsidiaries in Shenzhen and other locations. Overseas sales do not exceed 30% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianli Lithium Energy operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on cathode material production. It manages upstream raw material procurement, including lithium carbonate and precursors, and supplies downstream battery manufacturers. The company also engages in lithium carbonate recycling to secure raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in high-nickel ternary materials (9-series and ultra-high nickel), single crystal materials, and composite systems to improve energy density, cycle life, and safety. The company emphasizes cost reduction, supply chain optimization, green manufacturing, and expanding recycling capabilities. It also plans to explore solid-state battery materials and broaden applications in emerging markets like electric two-wheelers and drones.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of lithium-ion battery cathode materials, including ternary materials, lithium iron phosphate, and lithium carbonate. The company uses a cost-plus pricing mechanism, with sales primarily conducted via direct sales channels to battery manufacturers. Payment terms typically involve bank acceptance bills with credit periods of 60 to 120 days.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly competitive lithium battery cathode materials market characterized by rapid technological iteration and capacity expansion. It holds a significant position in the small power battery segment and maintains a competitive edge through technological innovation, a broad patent portfolio, and strategic customer collaborations. Market competition is intense, with pressure from raw material price volatility and industry consolidation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tianli Lithium Energy reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.75 billion, a 28.23% decline from the previous year, primarily due to raw material price drops and market demand fluctuations. The company incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 428.91 million, though the loss narrowed compared to 2023. Total assets stood at about RMB 2.81 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 1.44 billion. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing capacity expansions and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianli Lithium Energy emphasizes high-performance, high-consistency ternary cathode materials tailored for diverse customer needs, including high energy density, long cycle life, and safety. Its competitive differentiation lies in its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and integrated recycling business that enhances raw material supply stability and cost control. The company also focuses on green manufacturing and supply chain resilience to meet evolving market and regulatory demands.
